import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pt = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer tk = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(tk.nextToken()), m = Integer.parseInt(tk.nextToken());
        if (n > m) { int t = m; m = n; n = t; }
        int[][] f = new int[n][m];
        int res = Integer.MAX_VALUE, step = 1, numFree = n * m;
        int cur = 0;
        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

        class Solver {
            void rec(int x, int y) {
                if (numFree == 0) {
                    res = Math.min(res, cur);
                    return;
                }
                if (x >= n) return;
                if (y >= m) {
                    rec(x + 1, 0);
                    return;
                }
                if (f[x][y] != 0) {
                    rec(x, y + 1);
                    return;
                }

                put(x,y);
                rec(x, y + 1);
                remove(x, y);

                if (isValid(x + 1, y)) {
                    put(x + 1, y);
                    rec(x, y + 1);
                    remove(x + 1, y);
                }

                if (isValid(x, y + 1)) {
                    put(x, y + 1);
                    rec(x, y + 1);
                    remove(x, y + 1);
                }
            }

            void put(int x, int y) {
                for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
                    int nx=x+dx[i], ny=y+dy[i];
                    if (isValid(nx, ny)) {
                        if (f[nx][ny]==0) {
                            --numFree;
                            f[nx][ny]=step;
                        }
                    }
                }
                step++;
                cur++;
            }
            void remove(int x, int y) {
                step--;
                for (int i=0; i<5; i++) {
                    int nx=x+dx[i], ny=y+dy[i];
                    if (isValid(nx, ny)){
                        if (f[nx][ny]==step){
                            ++numFree;
                            f[nx][ny]=0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                cur--;
            }
            boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
                return x>=0 && y>=0 && x<n && y<m;
            }
        }

        new Solver().rec(0,0);
        pt.println(n*m - res);
        pt.close();
    }
}

        int[][] grid = new int[n][m];
        int minRemaining = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        int stepCount = 1;
        int freeCells = n * m;
        int currentOccupancy = 0;

        class PuzzleSolver {
            void solveRec(int x, int y) {
                if (freeCells == 0) {
                    minRemaining = Math.min(minRemaining, currentOccupancy);
                    return;
                }
                if (x >= n) return;
                if (y >= m) {
                    solveRec(x + 1, 0);
                    return;
                }
                if (grid[x][y] != 0) {
                    solveRec(x, y + 1);
                    return;
                }

                placeTile(x,y);
                solveRec(x, y + 1);
                removeTile(x,y);

                if (isCellValid(x + 1, y)) {
                    placeTile(x + 1, y);
                    solveRec(x, y + 1);
                    removeTile(x + 1, y);
                }
                if (isCellValid(x, y + 1)) {
                    placeTile(x, y + 1);
                    solveRec(x, y + 1);
                    removeTile(x, y + 1);
                }
            }

            void placeTile(int x, int y) {
                int[] dxs = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
                int[] dys = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};
                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                    int nx = x + dxs[i], ny = y + dys[i];
                    if (isCellValid(nx, ny) && grid[nx][ny] == 0) {
                        grid[nx][ny] = stepCount;
                        freeCells--;
                    }
                }
                stepCount++;
                currentOccupancy++;
            }

            void removeTile(int x, int y) {
                stepCount--;
                int[] dxs = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
                int[] dys = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};
                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                    int nx = x + dxs[i], ny = y + dys[i];
                    if (isCellValid(nx, ny) && grid[nx][ny] == stepCount) {
                        grid[nx][ny] = 0;
                        freeCells++;
                    }
                }
                currentOccupancy--;
            }

            boolean isCellValid(int x, int y) {
                return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < m;
            }
        }

        new PuzzleSolver().solveRec(0, 0);
        writer.println(n * m - minRemaining);

                    return;

                if (canPlace(x + 1, y)) {

                    back(x, y + 1);
                    undoPlacement(x + 1, y);
                }
                if (canPlace(x, y + 1)) {

            void doPlacement(int x, int y) {

                int[] dys = {0,1,0,-1,0};

                    int nx = x + dxs[dir], ny = y + dys[dir];
                    if (nx>=0 && ny>=0 && nx<n && ny<m && layout[nx][ny]==0) {
                        layout[nx][ny]=step;
                        freeCount--;
                    }
                }
                step++;
                occupancy++;
            }
            void undoPlacement(int x, int y) {
                step--;
                int[] dxs = {-1,0,1,0,0};
                int[] dys = {0,1,0,-1,0};
                for (int dir=0; dir<5; dir++) {

                    if (nx>=0 && ny>=0 && nx<n && ny<m && layout[nx][ny]==step) {

                        freeCount++;
                    }
                }
                occupancy--;
            }
            boolean canPlace(int x, int y) {
                return x>=0 && y>=0 && x<n && y<m;

        }

        new Backtracker().back(0,0);
        pw.println(n*m - best);

import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader buf = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(buf.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()), m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        if(n > m){ int t=m; m=n; n=t; }
        int[][] grid = new int[n][m];
        int bestRemaining = Integer.MAX_VALUE, stepID=1, freeCellsTotal=n*m, occupiedCount=0;

        class DFS {
            void go(int x, int y) {
                if (freeCellsTotal==0) { bestRemaining=Math.min(bestRemaining, occupiedCount); return; }
                if (x>=n) return;
                if (y>=m) { go(x+1,0); return; }
                if (grid[x][y]!=0) { go(x,y+1); return; }

                cover(x,y);
                go(x,y+1);
                uncover(x,y);

                if (isValidCell(x+1,y)) {
                    cover(x+1,y);
                    go(x,y+1);
                    uncover(x+1,y);
                }

                if (isValidCell(x,y+1)) {
                    cover(x,y+1);
                    go(x,y+1);
                    uncover(x,y+1);
                }
            }

            void cover(int x, int y) {
                int[] deltaX={-1,0,1,0,0};
                int[] deltaY={0,1,0,-1,0};
                for (int dir=0; dir<5; dir++) {
                    int nx=x+deltaX[dir], ny=y+deltaY[dir];
                    if (nx>=0 && ny>=0 && nx<n && ny<m && grid[nx][ny]==0) {
                        grid[nx][ny]=stepID; freeCellsTotal--;
                    }
                }
                stepID++;
                occupiedCount++;
            }

            void uncover(int x, int y) {
                stepID--;
                int[] deltaX={-1,0,1,0,0};
                int[] deltaY={0,1,0,-1,0};
                for (int dir=0; dir<5; dir++) {
                    int nx=x+deltaX[dir], ny=y+deltaY[dir];
                    if (nx>=0 && ny>=0 && nx<n && ny<m && grid[nx][ny]==stepID) {
                        grid[nx][ny]=0;
                        freeCellsTotal++;
                    }
                }
                occupiedCount--;
            }

            boolean isValidCell(int x, int y) {
                return x>=0 && y>=0 && x<n && y<m;
            }
        }

        new DFS().go(0,0);
        pw.println(n*m - bestRemaining);
